mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strong economic growth, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 5% (FEDFUNDS > 5%) signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing borrowing costs and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and rising INDPRO (above 110) indicates strong industrial production, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased economic activity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% monthly increase in RSAFS, indicating strong retail sales, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of months with RSAFS growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL growth is below 2% YoY, signaling controlled inflation during a tightening cycle, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with controlled inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery (UNRATE > 6%), a decrease in UNRATE by 1% over 3 months signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease > 1% in 3 months, starting from UNRATE > 6%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of post-shock recovery instances with UNRATE decrease > 1% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high HOUST (above 1500), indicating strong housing market activity, contributes to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased economic activity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.
